name: Podwise
description: Podcast knowledge for AI agents. Search podcasts and episodes, pull a full transcript, read the AI summary, chapters, highlights, Q&A and mind map, ask questions across transcripts, translate an episode, clip key moments, and export notes as Markdown or SRT. 38 tools. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth; tool calls require a Podwise account on a Pro or Enterprise plan. Docs: https://docs.podwise.ai/mcp. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.hardhackerlabs/podwise.
author: Hardhacker Labs
